item.title: KCPD Holds Taxpayers Hostage While Shielding a Killer in Blue
item.description: The department has received $1.2 billion since 2022. Now it claims it can't afford basic services while an officer who has killed three people remains on patrol. A Kansas City Defender investigation. The post KCPD Holds Taxpayers Hostage While Shielding a Killer in Blue appeared first on The Kansas City Defender.

item.title: The Defender’s Abolitionist Freedom School Is Back — Cohort 3 Applications Now Open
item.description: The Defender's Abolitionist Freedom School is accepting applications for Cohort 3. item.title: Independence Residents Fight a $6.6 Billion Data Center as Monday’s Tax Break Vote Looms
item.description: Independence is the latest front in a nationwide battle over data centers. On Monday, the city council will vote on whether to hand billions in tax breaks to a Dutch tech company for a project that, at full scale, will consume 18 times more electricity than every home in the city combined. Residents say they were never consulted. The post Independence Residents Fight a $6.6 Billion Data Center as Monday’s Tax Break Vote Looms appeared first on The Kansas City Defender.

item.title: ‘Everything Must Go!’ Blacks on the Continent and in the Diaspora Experiencing a Crisis of Ownership
item.description: From Kenya's fire sale of Safaricom to skyrocketing utility bills in Black neighborhoods across America, privatization is reversing the gains of liberation movements worldwide. The second installment of Jon Jeter's Plunder Papers. The post ‘Everything Must Go!’ Blacks on the Continent and in the Diaspora Experiencing a Crisis of Ownership appeared first on The Kansas City Defender.

item.title: Who the Terrorists Are: On the American-Israeli War in Iran
item.description: They killed 165 schoolgirls on a Saturday morning, bragged about obtaining "complete control of Iranian skies," and plunged the planet into its most dangerous military crisis since 1945. A radical examination of American empire's suicidal hubris, the intelligence operations that manufactured the pretext, and the media apparatus selling civilizational destruction as foreign policy. The post Who the Terrorists Are: On the American-Israeli War in Iran appeared first on The Kansas City Defender.

item.title: CoreCivic Kills People. Leavenworth Is Voting on Whether to Let Them Do It Here.
item.description: Leavenworth was founded by pro-slavery settlers and became the epicenter of Bleeding Kansas. That same city votes today on whether to resurrect a CoreCivic detention facility — a company that has already killed people in its custody — and open a 1,000-bed ICE camp to kidnap, cage, and disappear immigrants from our region.
